label: B25-CLOCK
title: Implement the real 100-to-25 MHz logic clock and constraints
write_regions: fpga/catapult_a10/rtl/lcvex_catapult_a10_top.sv::board clock generator and Qsys clock-port wiring only
forbidden_regions: clk_y3 or EMIF PLL/reference frequency changes
shared manifests/checkers/test registry, QEMU, assembler and board actions
scope: Produce an actual 25 MHz CPU/SoC clock from clk_u59=100 MHz, retain the required Qsys auxiliary and clk_y3 EMIF reference clocks, update TimeQuest generated-clock constraints, and document reset timing at 25 MHz.
validation: Focused simulation proves divide-by-four period/duty/reset behavior; static checks prove sys_clk_25 exists in RTL and SDC and that EMIF reference clocks were not silently reduced.
acceptance: Hardware and SDC describe the same real 25 MHz clock; no new unsynchronized functional crossing is introduced; LOGIC_POR_CYCLES=65536 is documented as about 2.62 ms.
resource: No heavy or remote job in the lane; parent owns merged validation and T-042 owns physical measurement.

result.status: accepted; Verilator and Icarus integration focused rerun pass
